authority: User approved environment materialization, synthetic validation and conditional S00 smoke before review/commit.
uncommitted_execution: Explicitly authorized by this assignment; each run records implementation hashes. No HPC job is authorized.
fitting_cells: all supplied eligible cells; compare actual cells_step1 identities and order
final_correction: sctransform::correct_counts(raw, fitted model, scale_factor=explicit common depth)

synthetic.generator: NumPy PCG64, seed 1448145, negative binomial size=3; gene means geomspace(0.3,8,300), cell depths lognormal(0,0.45)
synthetic.depth_rule: minimum of the two raw panel-count medians, independently computed in Python
synthetic.repeat_comparison: exact semantic hashes of model parameters, fitting cells, corrected counts and log1p response; timestamps excluded

S00.repeat_scope: numerical repeatability on the subset; not evidence of repeated full-S00 fitting

memory_measurement: actual x64 Rscript process peak_wset, sampled every 0.2 seconds
